tasks.instruction_text: I'm scoping a Azure workload for a customer in East US — set up a quote for Basic (DTU — 5 DTU), override the default usage to 1460 VM-hours (2 VMs always-on) for the month, and pin the Standard tier since this is a regulated tenant.

Could you put together a Premium P2 (DTU — 250 DTU) quote? Always-on 1-month workload — use 730 DTU-hours (S2 always-on) — and bill it out of East US 2, the Developer tier is fine, we don't need anything fancier.
Need to estimate General Purpose (vCore — 2 vCore) sitting in Central US at about 100 vCore-hours. We're on the Basic tier anyway.
Configure the calculator for Business Critical (vCore — 2 vCore) in West US 2 — usage around 100 vCore-hours per month and we're already on the Professional Direct tier for the FedRAMP tenant.
What's the projected monthly bill for Hyperscale (vCore — 2 vCore) in South Central US doing 730 vCore-hours (Hyperscale always-on), with the Basic tier attached?
Quick check — if I put 1460 vCore-hours (2 vCore always-on) through Serverless (vCore — 1 vCore) in Brazil South, on the None tier, what does the monthly estimate come to?
Hmm, what would Basic (DTU — 5 DTU) cost me in Canada Central for a 1460 VM-hours (2 VMs always-on) monthly commitment if I add the Standard tier on top? Just want the number.

Pricing exercise for a finance review: configure the calculator for Business Critical (vCore — 2 vCore) in West Europe, override usage to 100 vCore-hours, leave support at the Basic tier, then tell me the all-in monthly total — they want it for the budget doc.

OK so I need to estimate Premium P2 (DTU — 250 DTU) running in North Europe for one month — use 730 DTU-hours (S2 always-on) — and we're on the Developer tier; set it up in the calculator and give me the monthly figure.

Hey, can you set up an estimate for 1460 vCore-hours (2 vCore always-on) out of UK South on Serverless (vCore — 1 vCore) and tell me the monthly cost? We're on the Basic tier, but if it's over $1000/month we'll probably want to revisit.
